title: June 16, 1976
span: June to August 1976, Soweto and beyond
summary: Students marched against being taught in Afrikaans and were met with police gunfire. The uprising spread across the country and brought a new generation into the struggle.
caveat: Well documented in photographs, press reports and later testimony, including to the Truth and Reconciliation Commission. The number of people killed is disputed.

stops.title: Naledi High School
stops.narration: Students here had already been organising against a 1974 order that half of all subjects be taught in Afrikaans. On the morning of the 16th, they set out to join students from other schools.
sources: Sifiso Mxolisi Ndlovu, The Soweto Uprisings: Counter-memories of June 1976 (1998)
Alan Brooks and Jeremy Brickhill, Whirlwind Before the Storm (1980)

stops.title: Morris Isaacson High School
stops.narration: Student leader Tsietsi Mashinini addressed pupils here before the march. Columns from different schools converged and headed for Orlando Stadium.
sources: Sifiso Mxolisi Ndlovu, The Soweto Uprisings: Counter-memories of June 1976 (1998)
Alan Brooks and Jeremy Brickhill, Whirlwind Before the Storm (1980)

stops.title: Orlando West
stops.narration: Near Orlando West High School, police opened fire on the marchers. Sam Nzima photographed 12-year-old Hector Pieterson being carried by Mbuyisa Makhubo; the image went around the world. The Hector Pieterson Museum stands here.
sources: Sifiso Mxolisi Ndlovu, The Soweto Uprisings: Counter-memories of June 1976 (1998)
Helena Pohlandt-McCormick, "I Saw a Nightmare...": Doing Violence to Memory (2005)

stops.title: Orlando Stadium
stops.narration: The stadium was the planned destination of the march. Students never reached it as the day turned into running battles with police across Soweto.
sources: Alan Brooks and Jeremy Brickhill, Whirlwind Before the Storm (1980)

stops.title: Alexandra
stops.narration: Within days, the protests spread to other townships around Johannesburg, including Alexandra, and then to the rest of the country.
sources: Alan Brooks and Jeremy Brickhill, Whirlwind Before the Storm (1980)

stops.title: Langa
stops.narration: Students in Cape Town's townships rose up in August, and protests continued into 1977. The official death toll was 176; other estimates run to several hundred.
stops.confidence_note: The death toll is disputed: official figures were lower than independent estimates.
sources: Alan Brooks and Jeremy Brickhill, Whirlwind Before the Storm (1980)
Truth and Reconciliation Commission of South Africa Report (1998)
